lines: Even if they are the same level, Pokemon can have very different abilities.
A Pokemon raised by a trainer is stronger than one in the wild.
I think Pokemon can be good or evil.
It depends on the trainer.
You can't win with just one strong Pokemon.
It's tough, but you have to raise them evenly.
Pokemon can still learn techniques after canceling evolution.
Evolution can wait until new moves have been learned.
Pokemon CENTERS are wonderful! They heal Pokemon completely.
Even conditions like sleep, burn, poison and others are cured.
It is true that a higher level Pokemon will be more powerful...
But, all Pokemon will have weak points against specific types.
So, there is no universally strong Pokemon.
Have you seen any Rare Candy?
It's supposed to make Pokemon go up one level!
You're a trainer too?
Collecting, fighting, it's a tough life.
There's a Pokemon Center in every town.
They don't charge any money either!
Technology is incredible!
You can now store and recall Pokemon as data via PC!
Coming up with nicknames is fun, but hard.
Simple names are the easiest to remember.
Good things can happen if you raise Pokemon diligently, even the weak ones!
A shady, old man got me to buy this really weird fish Pokemon!
It's totally weak and it cost P500!
Pokemon learn new techniques as they grow!
But, some moves must be taught by the trainer!
Pokemon become easier to catch when they are hurt or asleep!
But, it's not a sure thing!
Many Pokemon live only in forests and caves.
You need to look everywhere to get different kinds!
I ran out of POKE BALLs to catch Pokemon with! You should carry extras!
Did you try X SPEED? It speeds up a Pokemon in battle!
You know Revive? It revives any fainted Pokemon!
I was given a PP UP as a gift. It's used for increasing the PP of techniques!
